title: 5/09 deploy of 68e4cdb failed its canary while the scheduler sat in a clean-exit auto-restart; canary relaxed to accept that state
tier_reason: one deploy failed and (per the workflow) rolled back; the same source went out 8 minutes later; no delivery or state impact evidenced

contract.text: The deploy canary passes a deploy whose services are healthy and rolls back only deploys that leave a service failed.

mechanism.text: canary check 1 required `systemctl is-active bts-scheduler` == active; at the deploy the scheduler was activating/auto-restart after a clean exit (Result=success, status 0), so the check failed, the workflow's failure branch ran and the run concluded failure

verified_recovered.how: run 25614364730 (same src plus the relaxed canary) concluded success

watchdog.trigger: a deploy run concludes failure or rolls back: record the canary's failing check and the scheduler's ActiveState/SubState/Result, and compare the box HEAD with the pushed SHA
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the next deploy of the same source concludes success and the box HEAD equals it

evidence.what: deploy-branch push of head 68e4cdb created 2026-05-09T23:13:29Z (19:13:29 ET), conclusion failure; log unavailable_expired
deploy of head ac4a959 (68e4cdb plus the canary change; no src difference) created 2026-05-09T23:21:06Z, conclusion success

treat the scheduler as healthy when active or when systemd reports a clean Restart=always auto-restart cycle after day completion; keep rollback for failed states and nonzero exits; include state details in the failure reason
the same evening the scheduler was 'exiting immediately after day completion and being relaunched repeatedly by Restart=always' (next-wake computed in the past) - the state the canary saw

notes: the cause (clean auto-restart state) is inferred from ac4a959's change and 864d3aa's body 8-15 min later; the run log with the canary's failure reason has expired; whether the rollback executed is inferred from the failure branch (deploy_history.txt reflog in B1 can confirm)

alternative reading: the canary may have been a TRUE detection of the I-049 restart loop, and ac4a959's relaxation means a deploy landing during any clean-exit restart loop now passes check 1 (still present in deploy.yml at HEAD) - my analysis, not a documented residual; if the lead accepts it, list it as a residual (reaches production) and apply B-to-A
merge with I-049? same evening, causally linked
the reverted deploy carried the 68e4cdb polling-gate fix (I-043 link 3), delayed by 8 min
detection latency 0-7.3 min: the canary ran within the run (19:13:29) and the operator had reacted by 19:20:48
